prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic dynamic medium fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman in a dark industrial environment with red backlight.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult East Asian woman with sharp editorial features, extremely vibrant electric-orange hair flowing wildly in strong wind, cool detached expression and nude glossy lips. She wears a fitted black tube top or bodice with supplied white chest graphic, loose white textured fabric, orange-tinted futuristic sunglasses, chunky silver chain and long rhinestone earrings.
composition_elements: Chest-up medium shot angled to the side, subject leaning into frame with upper body twisting in motion and gaze past her shoulder.
Hair sweeps across the left side with individual strands illuminated; intentional motion blur conveys movement.
Dark industrial grid or window structure with red gel backlight, direct flash and hard shadows.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong red gel backlight on the hair and background with direct slightly harsh flash on the subject, high contrast and sharp jewelry highlights.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, 35mm lens at f/2.8, face in focus with artistic hair motion blur, visible analog grain, late-1990s/early-2000s editorial treatment, no added text or watermark.
